verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party Device Authorization plugin that implements the RFC 8628 code issuance and approval flow, explicitly targeting CLI applications and other limited-input devices. The docs also say the flow can be tried right away using the Better Auth CLI, so CLIs can authenticate without pasting long-lived secrets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless AI agent use cases and the resulting token/session handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the device flow.
